subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Name different types of holidays and tourism
Match key words to tour advertisements
Discuss the benefits and disadvantages of tourism

tf.s: A cruise is a holiday on a big ship.
tf.why: Yes! A cruise is usually relaxing.

tf.s: An adventure holiday could be dangerous.
tf.why: Right! Adventure holidays can include risky activities.

tf.s: A camping trip is usually very expensive.
tf.why: A camping trip is a cheap holiday.

tf.s: Bungee jumping is part of extreme sports tourism.
tf.why: Correct! It is an exciting extreme sport.

tf.s: Whale watching belongs to cultural tourism.
tf.why: Whale watching belongs to wildlife holidays.

tf.s: Local festivals and museums belong to cultural tourism.
tf.why: Yes, they show the culture of a place.

tf.s: The ad about a hotel built of ice is about ice tourism.
tf.why: Right! The hotel melts in early spring.

tf.s: The cooking holidays advert is about creating a work of art.
tf.why: Creating a work of art matches the painting holidays advert.

tf.s: Foreign tourism can help the economy and create jobs.
tf.why: Good! Tourism brings money and work.

tf.s: Foreign tourism can never change local traditions.
tf.why: One disadvantage is that tourism can change local traditions.

boxes.q: What type of holiday is a trip on a big ship?
boxes.why: A cruise is on a big ship.

boxes.q: Which type of tourism uses bungee jumping?
boxes.why: Bungee jumping is an extreme sport.

boxes.q: Which type is going on safari?
boxes.why: On safari you see wild animals.

boxes.q: What do you do on a sightseeing tour?
o: see the famous places of a town

boxes.why: A cruise is calm and relaxing.

boxes.q: Which phrases belong to sailing holidays?
Which advert is about 'visiting local markets'?
boxes.why: Cooks visit markets to buy food.

boxes.q: Which advert is about 'a variety of physical activities'?
Complete: Foreign tourism helps to promote international ___.
boxes.why: Tourism helps people understand other cultures.

boxes.q: Which is a disadvantage of tourism?
boxes.why: Too many tourists can make places crowded.

mcq.q: Which two phrases belong to cultural tourism?
o: local festivals and museums and theatres
mcq.why: Culture is about traditions, arts and history.

mcq.q: Which two phrases belong to wildlife holidays?
o: going on safari and whale watching

mcq.q: Which is a benefit of foreign tourism?
mcq.why: Tourists spend money and create jobs.

mcq.q: Which key word in 'accommodation that disappears' leads you to the ice hotel ad?
o: 'disappears' links to 'the hotel melts in early spring'
mcq.why: Underline key words and find them in the ads.

mcq.q: Your family wants a calm, relaxing holiday. Which is the best choice?
Which phrase from Activity 4 matches the safari advert?
mcq.why: On safari you see wild animals.

mcq.q: Why do 'yacht hire' and 'experienced crews' belong to sailing holidays?
o: Both are connected with boats and sailing
mcq.why: Use the topic of the key words to match them.

mcq.q: Why does the Top Tip tell you to underline key words before matching?
o: Key words help you find the right advert quickly
You do not need to read the adverts
mcq.why: Key words link the phrase to the text.

mcq.q: Which sentence is the best concluding sentence for a paragraph about tourism in Oman?
o: In conclusion, tourism brings many benefits to Oman, but we must protect our traditions.
Bungee jumping is an extreme sport.
mcq.why: A concluding sentence sums up the main points.
